message.content:
# Gap List — Figma (Image 1) vs Build (Image 2)

## 1. Header / Wordmark — **DIFFERENT**
- Figma: script/cursive "Atur Seva" wordmark centered in header; left = location pill with location-pin icon and chevron; right = single bell icon with red notification dot. No gear icon, no account icon in header.
- Build: "AturSeva" in bold sans-serif, left-aligned, overlapping the status bar (no safe-area top padding). Right side has large grey circular buttons for bell + account, plus an oversized floating grey settings gear icon — none exist in Figma. Location moved to a second row as plain text (no pill/card treatment). Icons grey-filled, heavy circles.

## 2. Hero — **DIFFERENT**
- Figma: headline sits on one compact block, two lines ("Healthcare, / made simpler."), medium weight, illustration (hospital + doctor on grey rounded blob with green bushes) on right at moderate size, balanced 50/50 split, no white gap.
- Build: headline far larger/heavier, wraps to three lines, pushing the illustration down; illustration lacks the grey rounded backdrop blob and bushes are small; text-to-image spacing excessive; subtitle wraps to 3 lines vs 2.

## 3. Search — **CLOSE**
- Same pill shape, magnifier left, mic right, grey fill.
- Build: fill is slightly darker/flatter grey (#EEE vs near-white with subtle border); placeholder truncates ("tests,…" vs "symptoms…"); corner radius slightly larger; missing faint border/shadow of Figma pill.

## 4. Quick Action Cards — **DIFFERENT**
- Figma: white cards with soft drop shadow, radius ~16, compact height; illustration + bold title + one-line subtitle, no clipping.
- Build: light-grey flat cards (no white fill, no shadow); taller with vertical letterboxing; "Hospitals" illustration renders as low-res blurry version; titles wrap ("Video Consult", "OPD & Departments" break to 2 lines) because cards are narrower; subtitle wraps to 2 lines ("Consult from home").

## 5. Dark Token Banner — **DIFFERENT**
- Figma: black rounded banner; headline "Skip the wait. Book your token online." on two lines; the two feature chips ("⚡ Real-time queue", "📅 Confirmed slot") sit inline side-by-side in one row as plain text with icons; right side shows stacked white cards with "Token #24" clearly readable.
- Build: banner much taller; chips stacked vertically as pill-shaped grey buttons; headline wraps to 3 lines; token cards are blank white/grey rectangles — missing the "Token #24" label entirely; bottom of banner is cut off/overlapped by bottom nav; radius larger.

## 6. Appointment Card — **MISSING**
- Figma: "Your appointment" section header with "View all →", card with doctor avatar, "Dr. Adam Max / Psychologist • City Care Clinic", green "● Live Queue" pill, token stats row (#24 Your Token | #18 Now Serving | 06 Patients Ahead) with dividers, chevron button, and progress bar.
- Build: absent (only a different "Have a booking? Track your token" teaser below the fold — not the same component).

## 7. Specialty Cards — **MISSING**
- Figma: "Explore by Specialty" header + "View all →"; 6 white rounded tiles with line icons: Cardiology, Pulmonology, Neurology, Gastro, Gynecology, More.
- Build: not present in viewport (possibly below fold, but not implemented in visible layout).

## 8. Lab Promo — **MISSING**
- Figma: light-green rounded banner, "Book Lab Tests from trusted labs", "Home collection available", dark "Book Tests →" pill button, microscope + test tubes illustration.
- Build: not visible/implemented on the home screen.

## 9. Bottom Nav — **DIFFERENT**
- Figma: white rounded floating pill bar, subtle shadow, active "Home" in light-grey pill with filled black home icon; Bookings = calendar, Health Records = medical briefcase, Account = person outline.
- Build: flat white bar (no floating pill radius/shadow); active Home shown as black square tile with white icon (inverted, wrong); Bookings icon differs (calendar-with-check vs calendar); Health Records icon differs (clipboard vs briefcase); bar overlaps/clips the token banner content; nav sits above a grey system bar not in Figma.

---

# Top 8 Ranked Gaps to Fix

1. **Add the "Your appointment" card** — completely missing; core feature (avatar, Live Queue pill, #24/#18/06 stats, progress bar, View all link).
2. **Add "Explore by Specialty" tiles and "Book Lab Tests" promo banner** — both entire sections absent from the build.
3. **Fix the header** — replace bold "AturSeva" with centered script wordmark, remove settings gear and circular account/bell buttons, add red notification dot, restore location pill, add status-bar safe-area padding.
4. **Fix the dark token banner** — inline the two feature chips on one row (not stacked pills), add "Token #24" text to the card stack, reduce height, and stop the bottom nav from overlapping it.
5. **Fix bottom nav** — floating rounded pill with shadow; active tab = light-grey pill + filled black icon (not black square); match calendar/briefcase icons.
6. **Restyle quick action cards** — white fill + soft shadow, tighter height, wider cards so titles/subtitles fit on one line; replace blurry hospital illustration.
7. **Fix hero layout** — reduce headline size/weight to two lines, add grey rounded blob behind illustration, tighten vertical spacing.
8. **Polish search bar** — near-white fill with subtle border/shadow, full placeholder text ("symptoms…"), match radius.
